facts.title: Learn Tailoring
facts.location: Eldrin, house at the Eastvale Logging Camp
facts.note: No level requirement in Forever. Lawrence Schneider, Mage Quarter, Stormwind, also teaches Apprentice.

facts.title: Learn Tailoring
facts.note: No level requirement in Forever. Durotar has no Tailoring trainer. Kil'hala at the Crossroads also teaches Apprentice.

facts.title: Tailoring 1-55: Bolt of Linen Cloth, then Linen Belt
facts.note: 1-30: 30 Bolt of Linen Cloth (60 Linen Cloth); keep them all. 30-55: 28 Linen Belt (a bolt and a Coarse Thread each). Thread is sold by the Tailoring Supply vendor near most trainers.

facts.title: Journeyman Tailoring
facts.note: Needs Tailoring 50 and level 10. Mahani at Camp Taurajo also teaches Journeyman.

facts.title: Tailoring 55-125: wool, then silk bolts
facts.note: 55-80: 45 Bolt of Woolen Cloth (135 Wool Cloth); learn Journeyman first, they can take you past 75. 80-95 Woolen Cape; 95-100 Double-stitched Woolen Shoulders; 100-120 Bolt of Silk Cloth (keep them); 120-125 the shoulders again.

facts.title: Expert Tailoring is in Undercity
facts.note: Needs Tailoring 125 and level 20; 50 silver. He is the only Horde Expert trainer listed. The Spinning Wheel, a camp crafting station, needs Tailoring 140 and a blueprint from the Unstable Sentinel in the City of Dalaran.
